title: Bano ke bain the  ali asghar kidhar
body:
Haye Asghar haye Asghar haye Asghar haye Asghar
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Gurbat me maa ko chowd ke dilbar kidhar gaye
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Asghar e bezabaa'n , dhoonde tum ko ye maa
Ay mere neem jaa'n, kho gaye tum kaha'n
Hai maa tumhari yaad me , muztar kidhar gaye
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye.....!
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Khaali jhula kiye , goud viraa'n kiye
Maa ko tanha kiye , haye tum chal base
Kaise jiyegi Banu e muztar kidhar gaye
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye.....!
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Mere shash mahe ko , mujhse cheena gaya
Goud ujdi meri , bas gayi karbala
Sunsaan karke gowd ko dilbar kidhar gaye
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye.....!
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Mere ghuncha dahan , mere tashna dahan
Ay mere jaano tan , muntazir hai behen
Hai qaima -e- Hussain me , mehshar kidhar gaye
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye.....!
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Maa ko Armaan tha , ghutniyo tum chale
Khake teere jafa , haye tum chal base
Gham me tumhare roti hai , madar kidhar gaye
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye.....!
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Lashe Asghar liye , ayengi Fatima
Us ghadi hashr me , hoga mehshar bapa
Kya kya na zulm zahra ke , dil par guzar gaye
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye.....!
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Hai tamanna meri , shaah ke dilruba
Naseraane aza , pohnche Karbobala
Matam bapa hai shaah ke dilbar kidhar gaye
<<MINI>>
Bano ke bain the Ali asghar kidhar gaye.....!
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Qabr e besheer par , aayi jab Bibiyaa'n
Kyu'n na mout agayi , maa ki thi yeh fughaa'n
Hyder bapa hai shor ke , Asghar kidhar gaye
